walkthroughs.body_html:
Periodisation breaks training into:

  • Pre-season — build aerobic base and strength.
  • Peak/competition — maintain fitness, focus on tactics.
  • Off-season — active rest, recover, treat injuries.

This avoids overtraining and helps athletes peak when it counts.

At altitude there is less oxygen, so the body produces more red blood cells. When the athlete returns to sea level, oxygen transport is improved. Drawbacks include cost, time away from coach and altitude sickness.

Overtraining signs: rising resting HR, poor sleep, constant fatigue, mood swings, frequent illness and performance drops. The fix is rest, balanced nutrition and reduced load until recovery is complete.
